title: RosePO: Aligning LLM-based Recommenders with Human Values

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by calculating the difference between the logarithmic popularity of a recommended item and the average logarithmic popularity of the items in a user's historical interaction sequence.

Measured by computing the difference in cosine similarity of text embeddings between the recommended item and the historical sequence, compared to the similarity of the actual subsequent interacted item.
